tasks.description: Monthly Chromium rebase and dependency updates with full regression run.
Skill-format backward-compatibility tests against all prior schema versions.
Triage user-reported failures into new golden tasks.
Real-time Google Chrome CDP observation, WebSocket JSON-RPC duplex protocol, and Omnibox search/destination resolution engine (ADR-0009).

Fix New Tab search bar routing, prevent tab hijacking on catalog/shop keywords, and resolve external live site access for YouTube, Facebook, and redirected domains with anti-frame-busting shims and Chrome CDP rendering.

Integrate p-e-w/heretic refusal-free chat engine with OmniRoute and FreeLLMAPI gateways, build Braver frontpage with Google dark minimal pill search bar, and construct Google-style search results page with Meta Knowledge Graph collage card and structured sitelinks.

Dynamic live web search via DuckDuckGo and Wikipedia REST API, remove static demo tabs/shortcuts, and implement HackSuite pentesting workstation (ADR-0010) with HTTP repeater, attack surface analyzer, decoders, and refusal-free Heretic SecOps copilot.

Upgrade Braver AI Mode with intelligent, conversational refusal-free responses, implement full category coverage on SERP (AI Mode, All, Images, Videos, News, Forums) with AI Overview cards, and resolve HTTPS navigation issues with safe head injection, CSP meta stripping, __BRAVE_HOST__ bridge messaging, and animated progress feedback.

Resolve blank screen viewport rendering for SPAs (YouTube, Facebook, Google) with automatic CDP failover, enable full keyboard and mouse scroll forwarding to Chrome CDP, and provide native Google Chrome login window for 100% reliable 2FA/Passkey authentication with automatic profile session cookie synchronization.

Full UI/UX responsiveness across all screen sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop), multi-tab state preservation using independent dedicated iframes without reload, native in-webview rendering for YouTube and external sites without unwanted CDP kick-out, Brave Shields ad & tracker filtering, live user move telemetry tracking with skill memory & replay, and Copilot chatbot with 'See More' deep technical breakdowns and bilingual Bangla/English intelligence.

Brave New Tab page matching uploaded user screenshot (lush green leaves wallpaper, centered minimalist search pill, floating STATS card with 212k blocked trackers, and BRAVE VPN widget), default collapsed sidebar for full-screen clean browser view, real macOS Brave and Chrome session cookie sync (/api/chrome/sync-profile), ad-free YouTube experience in Web View, and restored natural mouse cursor in Live Chrome.

Fix Google 'refused to connect' error via igu=1 iframe embed normalization, implement full cross-device responsive UI layout (desktop, tablet, mobile), add one-click Google Search provider toggle, and enable automated GitHub Pages deployment.

Direct Google Search integration across omnibox, New Tab search bar, autocomplete, and SERP forwarding with igu=1; client-side refusal-free Braver AI copilot engine with deep technical breakdown; client-side autonomous agent trajectory synthesis with animated cursor and human handoff; and non-blocking toast notifications replacing browser alert popups.

In-browser autonomous backend engine running via Service Worker (sw.js) and transparent client-side fetch router, eliminating localhost requirements on GitHub Pages; and universal web unblocker providing active interactive experiences for YouTube, Facebook, and search results without frame connection refusal errors (ADR-0012).

Skill cryptographic signing and verification (ADR-0013) using Node.js native Ed25519 signatures, canonical JSON payload digest verification, SkillKeyring trust management, and import review gating (resolving OQ-004); plus Web Speech API voice search integration in search.html (resolving OQ-003).

Universal Web Unblocker Proxy Pipeline: Fix Chromium 'refused to connect' connection refusal on arbitrary external URLs by routing non-embeddable destinations through high-performance /api/proxy (stripping X-Frame-Options and CSP frame-ancestors, neutralizing frame busting, injecting base href and live telemetry bridge), updating Service Worker /api/* fetch handler to Network-First so Node.js proxy is utilized on localhost:3000, configuring process.env.NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = '0' and expanding fetch timeout to 10s, and removing premature blank iframe portal hijacker.

Search Bot & Captcha Elimination: Route web searches to native Braver Search SERP (search.html) with full AI Overview, Knowledge Panel, and multi-category media tabs, removing forced Google igu=1 redirects that trigger 'unusual traffic detected' reCAPTCHA challenges. Add unblocked DuckDuckGo webview search and clean external Google tab launch, and preserve internal pages without protocol or proxy mangling.

Viewport Refusal Elimination & Graceful CDP Fallback: Resolve CSS parse errors in public/style.css; eliminate 'refused to connect' dead screens on YouTube, GitHub, Facebook, and external sites on GitHub Pages via Shielded Web Portal (portal.html) and Service Worker v2 cache eviction; and replace black CDP offline viewport with graceful recovery card (btn-cdp-return-web, btn-cdp-launch-retry) and auto-return to Web View on omnibox navigation.

Vercel CLI Deployment & Universal Live Web Proxy Pipeline (ADR-0014): Add vercel.json (outputDirectory: public, cleanUrls, Service-Worker-Allowed: /), .vercelignore (excluding >6GB of vendor sources and heavy media assets to comply with Vercel upload limits), and api/proxy.js (zero-dependency edge serverless proxy stripping X-Frame-Options/CSP frame-ancestors, injecting base href and link/form interceptors). Fix isStaticOnlyHosting in public/app.js to eliminate unwanted portal redirects on Vercel deployments, allowing users to visit and browse every URL live without issues.

open_issues: OQ-001: Host filesystem capacity is constrained; Phase A strategy avoids local C++ Chromium compilation.
